name: NoPo Night Ride
schedule: Every Thursday, meet 7:45 pm, roll 8:05 pm sharp, from Columbia Park in front of the pool. Last Thursday of the month has a pre-ride social (Oct 29 spot to be announced).

start_location.name: Columbia Park, in front of the pool (between the pool building and the soccer field)

pace: About 10 mph, conversation pace; 8 to 15 miles
visitor_notes: Front and rear lights are required. No store stop, so bring snacks and water. Any bike that cruises at about 10 mph for an hour is fine. Check the air quality on smoky days.
description: A Thursday night ramble through North Portland and beyond, an hour or so, ending back at Columbia Park. The host calls it no-drop and says there is no agenda beyond riding bikes. Basket bikes, cruisers, gravel bikes and old bikes are all named as welcome.
evidence: Shift's calendar lists NoPo Night Ride for Thu Oct 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29, 2026: meet 7:45 pm, hard start 8:05 pm, Columbia Park (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

name: Friday Night Ride at LADDS
schedule: Every Friday, meet around 7 pm, ride around 8 pm, from the circle in Ladds Addition (covered area at Abernethy Elementary if it rains). Second Fridays run late to link up with the Midnight Mystery Ride.

start_location.name: The circle in Ladds Addition (Abernethy Elementary covered area if raining)

pace: Sporty social pace with some extra zip; 10 to 25 miles with store, park and art stops
visitor_notes: Not necessarily no-drop, especially in fall, winter and spring, so be self-sufficient and have a plan to get home. Bring lights, a lock and a cup. Pedal-assist e-bikes (class 1 and 2) are fine.
description: A Friday night social ride out of Ladds Addition for people who like a sporty pace and adventurous routes. Expect 15 to 25 miles with some climbing and a faster speed than a typical Pedalpalooza ride. The host says guest ride leaders are welcome.
evidence: Shift's calendar lists Friday Night Ride at LADDS every Friday from Oct 2 to Nov 27, 2026: meet 7ish, ride 8ish (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

name: PSU Farmers Market Ride
schedule: Every Saturday the market is open, year round except the weekend between Christmas and New Year. Meet SE Clinton St and 41st Ave at 10:00 (ride 10:05); join at SE Clinton and 26th at 10:10 (ride 10:15) or the Tilikum Bridge at about 10:25 (leave 10:30); arrive at the market about 11:00.

start_location.name: SE Clinton St and 41st Ave, Clinton Neighborhood Greenway

visitor_notes: Different riders lead the route each week. Weather closures are posted on the listing.
description: A community-led Saturday ride from the Clinton greenway to the Portland State University farmers market. Three meeting points let you join along the way, and the group arrives around 11 am.
evidence: Shift's calendar lists the PSU Farmers Market Ride every Saturday from Oct 3 to Dec 19, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

name: King Farmer's Market Ride

visitor_notes: Hop on anywhere along the route. It follows the Mason bike lane and the Going and 32nd greenways to the King Farmers Market.

name: Corvidae BC Monthly Ride
schedule: Second Sunday of every month. Hang out at 1 pm, wheels down at 2 pm sharp, from Peninsula Park Rose Fountain (or the gazebo, depending on weather).

start_location.address: 700 N Rosa Parks Way, Portland, OR 97217

pace: Casual, about 10 miles with a few park stops
visitor_notes: Bring a repair kit and a spare tube, and your own food; the group stops near stores, not at them. Each month a different member leads. The club has a code of conduct.
description: A monthly no-drop ride, going since 2017, led by a different Corvidae member each month. It leans on greenways, group etiquette and safety. Pop-up rides run in summer, and the club collects dry non-perishables for food donations each month.

name: Overlook Bike Ride
schedule: Second Sunday of every month. Meet 9:30 am for coffee at Stacks Coffeehouse, depart 10:15 am. A loop of under 6 miles, about an hour.
visitor_notes: Free and family-friendly. Each month's route is a loop through the neighborhood's bike paths and destinations.
description: A monthly neighbor ride led by the Overlook Neighborhood Association's transportation chair. It meets for coffee, then rolls an hour-long loop of under six miles around Overlook.

name: MVBC Wednesday Night Gravel Ride
schedule: Wednesday evenings, year-round, 6:00 pm from Osborn Aquatic Center (extreme weather cancels). About 20 miles and 2,000 feet in 2 hours.

visitor_notes: Helmet required; non-members submit the liability waiver. Lights highly encouraged, plus flat repair gear and the downloaded route. OSU Research Forests prohibit e-bikes. Comfort on grades over 10 percent helps.
description: A no-drop mixed-surface night ride into McDonald Forest, with the evening view from Dimple Hill and a return via Oak Creek and the Midge Cramer path. The club rates it moderate to fast and aimed at a confident gravel rider.
